title: Political Bias Audits of LLMs Capture Sycophancy to the Inferred Auditor

bias_targets.methodology: Administering standard political questionnaires (Political Compass Test, Pew Political Typology, and Pew American Trends Panel items) to LLMs under a factorial experiment that varies the explicit political identity of the asker to measure sycophantic accommodation and shifts in ideological alignment.
